toplantilar.aciklama: Schedule meetings with clients and leads, send invitations, track RSVPs and keep minutes. Invitations go out by email with a calendar file (.ics); no Google account needed.

form.baslangicIpucu: Enter in Europe/Istanbul time; the server stores UTC.
form.jitsiIpucu: Paste your own link (Zoom, Teams…) or generate an unguessable Jitsi room. It is shared as a link only.
form.ekipYok: The team list is empty (add people under Support › Team).
form.cakismaBaslik: Conflict: these team members already have another meeting at this time

ayrinti.guncellemeUyari: The time or place changed after the invitation: send the update so attendees' calendars are updated.
ayrinti.silOnay: Delete this meeting? It can be restored from the trash.

tutanak.notlarIpucu: Markdown: # heading, - item, **bold**. Converted to safe HTML.
tutanak.paylasIpucu: Until shared, notes and decisions are visible to the team only; sharing notifies the client.

aksiyon.projeYok: Select a project for the meeting to convert items into tasks.

talep.aciklama: Requests clients sent from their panel (also shown in the Inbox). Scheduling a meeting closes the request.

abonelik.aciklama: Subscribe to your meetings in Google, Apple or Outlook calendar with a private address; new and changed meetings appear automatically.
abonelik.aciklamaYonetici: Generate a private calendar address for each team member: only the meetings that person attends are included. No Google account needed.
abonelik.adresNotu: This address is shown only now and is personal; do not share it. If you lose it, regenerate it (the old address stops working immediately).

tarif.baslik: How do I add it to my calendar?
tarif.google: Open Google Calendar on a computer › Other calendars › + › From URL › paste the address › Add calendar. Updates arrive every few hours.
tarif.apple: On iPhone: Settings › Calendar › Accounts › Add Account › Other › Add Subscribed Calendar; on Mac: Calendar › File › New Calendar Subscription › paste the address.
tarif.outlook: In Outlook: Calendar › Add calendar › Subscribe from web › paste the address › Import.
tarif.gizlilik: Anyone who knows the address can see your meetings; if in doubt, regenerate or revoke it.

musteri.aciklama: Meetings scheduled with the agency, your RSVP, shared notes and the action items assigned to you.
musteri.katilimciDegil: You are not among this meeting's attendees; attendees give the response.
musteri.paylasilmadi: The meeting notes have not been shared yet.

iste.aciklama: Write the topic and up to three time ranges that suit you; the agency will pick one and send an invitation.
iste.kart: Would you like to talk with the agency? Share times that suit you and we will plan the meeting together.
iste.gonderildi: Your request was sent to the agency.
iste.saatNotu: Times are entered in your browser's time zone.
